title: Onprem Field Scratchpad - Stella-Bio VPC Prep
content:
Quick dump from the site visit / pre-install call with Stella-Bio. Mostly reminder + things I ran into that I want to avoid repeating.

Context:
- Customer: Stella-Bio (stella-bio-prod VPC) — highly regulated, air-gapped option under evaluation.
- Contact: ops lead = Priam Rao (stella), net team = Claire Huang.
- Target: private deployment (VPC) with optional on-prem appliance for staging.
- OS baseline: RHEL 8.6 on hosts (we saw mix of 8.6 and some 9.x on dev boxes).

Top concerns / blockers seen today:
- Firewall rules: customer insisted on deny-by-default; we need explicit egress for puppet/ansible, yum repos, and k8s image registries. Make table for them.
- Proxy: corporate outbound proxy requires username:password auth — our install scripts assume tokenless egress; need wrapper.
- HSM/KMS: They want local HSM integration (Gemalto) for key wrapping. KMS integration POC needed early.
- MTU mismatch on VLANs: during node join we saw frequent TCP retransmits. Ask network to confirm jumbo frames disabled or consistent.
- NFS mounts for model artifacts: their storage team uses older NFSv3 appliance; verify file-lock semantics (we hit stale file handles once).
- GPU driver mismatch: node images had cuda-11.4 but our runtime prefers 11.7 — plan a driver upgrade path and staging.

Notes / commands that helped (keep handy):
- quick kubeadm join output clearing: sudo systemctl stop kubelet && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/kubelet/* /var/lib/etcd/* && reboot
- check iptables nat: sudo iptables -t nat -L -n -v | grep REDWOOD
- check docker overlay mount: mount | grep overlay
- fix DNS cache on nodes: sudo systemctl restart systemd-resolved || sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager

Customer-specific configuration (stella-bio):
- CIDR: 10.10.0.0/16 for production VPC (ask them if any subnets reserved for vendor appliances).
- Private registry: registry.stella.internal:5000 (requires mTLS client cert). Will need cert provisioning steps.
- Jumpbox required: bastion with fixed IP 10.10.0.11 — all admin ops must go through it.
- No direct internet for worker nodes. Egress must go through proxy or NAT gateway.
- HSM slot numbers: they provided test slot 2. Need to map to our KMS config template.

Install checklist (rough, personal):
- [ ] Pre-flight with customer net/security (confirm firewall rules below)
- [ ] Prepare airgap bundle if requested (images + helm charts)
- [ ] Create staging images with cuda 11.7 + driver 525.x, test locally
- [ ] Validate NFS mount behavior on RHEL 8.6 nodes
- [ ] Provide KMS/HSM POC steps and sample config (get certificate from security team)
- [ ] Create proxy-wrapper for yum/helm pulls (credentials-safe)
- [ ] Run smoke deployment in staging VPC behind bastion
- [ ] Collect performance baseline (p99 CPU/GPU utilization, network RTT)

Firewall rules I asked them to confirm (send as email copy to Claire):
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to our hosted repo endpoints: repo.redwood.ai (if using hosted)
- Allow outbound to registry.stella.internal:5000 from builder nodes via NAT/proxy
- Allow SSH from bastion IP 10.10.0.11 to worker/control plane nodes (custom port 2222)
- Allow mTLS to HSM appliance on port 5696 (confirm exact port with HSM vendor)

Troubleshooting notes (errors I saw):
- kubelet stuck CrashLoop on join: error mounting secret volume (permission denied) — fixed by ensuring /var/lib/kubelet owned by root:root and SELinux context restored (restorecon -Rv /var/lib/kubelet).
- Helm hooks failing in airgapped install: tiller hooks expect access to chartmuseum.api — workaround: rewrite helm hooks to local chartmuseum endpoint or set CHARTMUSEUM_URL env.
- long image pulls via proxy: proxy had small connection pool, timed out at 60s. For large pulls, set HTTP_PROXY timeout higher and chunk concurrently.

Reminders to self:
- Draft a short mini-runbook for ops team: quick restart steps, how to flush KV cache, how to rollback helm release to known-good revision. Keep it two pages max.
- Coordinate with security for HSM cert exchange: ask for sample CSR process and test slot creds.
- Re-run quantization benchmark after upgrade to cuda 11.7 (models/rebench/stella-quant).

Questions to confirm next call:
- Can we get an outbound whitelist subset rather than full internet egress for workers? Prefer whitelist.
- Will they allow a temporary NAT for initial image pulls? (helps speed install)
- Who owns the HSM admin account for provisioning? Contact name + contact window.

Logs / snippet to paste in tickets:
- example tcpdump capture note: saw RSTs when node tried to connect to registry.stella.internal:5000 at 2026-03-09T14:18:32Z — suggests proxy resets after 30s idle.
- kubeadm join failed: certificate has expired error (customer clock skew on VMs) — ask infra to NTP sync and re-issue certs.

Useful links to include in the follow-up email:
- checklist (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Private+Deploy+Checklist
- helm chart PR for airgap tweaks: https://github.com/redwood/helm-charts/pull/342
- KMS integration notes: confluence:KMS-onprem-guide

Quick end-of-day notes:
- Leah to own NFS verification with storage team (action: Leah to get list of exports + mount options).
- Evan to draft proxy wrapper script and test with internal dev registry.
- I will assemble the airgap image pack and a short runbook for the staging run.

Rough timeline estimate for next steps:
- 1 week: finalize proxy + image pack, NFS checks
- 2 weeks: KMS POC and GPU driver upgrade plan (staging pass)
- 3 weeks: full private deploy dry-run behind bastion

Random micro-notes (for next install):
- try mounting with noac option on NFS for heavy metadata workloads
- set sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max higher if pods create many short-lived connections
- consider ephemeral local cache for registry pulls to reduce pressure on proxy

End of scratchpad. Will clean up into a tidy runbook once we have confirmations.
